## Why This Is Asked

Assesses ability to translate a per-tenant health signal into concrete rate-limiting decisions, with dynamic adaptation and SLA guarantees.

```javascript
// Skeleton: CKNE -> quotas mapping
function quotasFromCKNE(ckne) {
  const base = 100; // max in-flight baseline
  const rate = 10 + 90 * ckne; // steady-state rate
  const burst = Math.max(0, Math.min(50, 50 * ckne));
  return {base, rate, burst};
}
```
